outline:
本課程為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動規劃自己興趣之主題。學生藉由特定主題之創造與實現中，培養獨立思考與分析判斷及問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。 學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
This course aims to develop self-learning skills. Students can propose their interests. Students will learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate students in problem solving. In this course, students are required to propose self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities and then submit their plans to the department for approval by the beginning of the semester.
schedule:
每週討論上一週遇到的問題的解決方法、目前的研究進度、下週研究目標的規劃。
The group meeting is held on every week. The intent of the presentations is to speak about the research updates and challenges.
assessment:
會議出席20%、期中計劃書40%、期末報告40%。
Attendance 20%, Midterm proposal 40%, Final report 40%.
